Taken apart.

Sensor signals in, a small fine-tuned AI model in the middle, one prediction out.

Smaller, then smaller.

AI scientists fine-tune thousands of candidate models at once and redraw the chip around the best.

The model, as gates.

The winning model is compiled into logic gates, with its weights wired in.

Checked, bit for bit.

The circuit runs every test window and must give the model's answer each time.

Every chip, a device.

Each chip the environment designs is the core of a different medical device.
